notes:
# v1.4.11 - a faster cold start and a more compact carousel

- Improved: Home opens noticeably faster from a cold start. The app now warms the
  right data before you arrive, and the Trending and Newest rows are loaded first
  instead of every row starting at once, so the top of Home fills in sooner.
- Improved: the update check no longer holds up the screen. It runs in the
  background, so a slow or offline check never delays the first content you see.
- Improved: rows now appear as soon as their data is ready. If a source is slow
  to answer, Home shows what has already arrived and fills in the rest, instead
  of waiting for the slowest source before showing anything.
- Improved: carousels are more compact - cards are a little smaller with tighter
  spacing, so more titles fit across each row (about three per row on the
  compact theme and four on the default, up from two and three).
- Fixed: a Home row no longer comes up empty when a source has changed its name;
  the app falls back to showing the titles it received.
- Fixed: a stalled response from a source no longer freezes the Trending row; the
  app gives up after a short wait and moves on.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
